title: Serve app-ads.txt at /app-ads.txt route

requirements.text: Ensure the static file `frontend/public/app-ads.txt` (containing the Google AdMob publisher verification entry for TetrisVerse) is publicly accessible at the URL path `/app-ads.txt`. No other files, components, or logic should be modified.

quotes: Sadece app-ads.txt dosyasını /app-ads.txt yolunda erişilebilir kılacağım — başka hiçbir şeye dokunmadan.

acceptanceCriteria: Navigating to https://tetrisverse-5h9.caffeine.xyz/app-ads.txt returns the raw app-ads.txt content (the AdMob publisher line).
No other frontend components, pages, or styles are changed.

constraints: Do not modify any frontend components, pages, styles, or backend code.
Only the app-ads.txt file placement/serving must be addressed.
The existing file at frontend/public/app-ads.txt must be used as-is.
nonGoals: Modifying the landing page or any existing component.
